2607.25484.title: Finding Optimal Cost-Bounded Plan Reductions: Refined Model
2607.25484.paper_summary: In some real applications a plan may later become unfeasible due to newly imposed budget constraints, yet, at the same time, using only the original actions of the plan and their order is mandatory. In this paper, we study the problem of extracting, from a precomputed plan, a valid subplan that maximizes utility while respecting a cost bound. Each goal is given a utility value and the plan is reduced by removing actions that support low-utility goals, while preserving both executability and the original action order. We show the decision variant is NP-complete and propose two exact methods to solve it: one via oversubscription planning (OSP) and another via Integer Linear Programming (ILP). This paper extends our previous work published at ICAPS 2026 (Del Toro, Fuentetaja, and García-Olaya 2026b). While the core framework remains as introduced there, we further introduce a refined ILP formulation that significantly decreases the model size and improves computational efficiency.
2607.25484.paper_summary_zh: 在某些實際應用中，由於新施加的預算限制，計畫可能會變得不可行，然而，同時僅使用計畫的原始行動及其順序是必須的。<lb/>在本文中，我們研究從預先計算的計畫中提取有效子計畫的問題，該子計畫在遵循成本限制的同時最大化效用。<lb/>每個目標都有一個效用值，計畫通過移除支持低效用目標的行動來減少，同時保留可執行性和原始行動順序。<lb/>我們顯示決策變體是 NP 完全的，並提出兩種精確的方法來解決它：一種是通過超額訂閱規劃 (OSP)，另一種是通過整數線性規劃 (ILP)。<lb/>本文擴展了我們在 ICAPS 2026 發表的先前工作 (Del Toro, Fuentetaja, 和 García-Olaya 2026b)。<lb/>雖然核心框架保持如前所述，但我們進一步引入了一種精煉的 ILP 公式，顯著減少了模型大小並提高了計算效率。
